title: Getting Started
description: Follow this step-by-step guide to set up your WoltFlow automation in under 10 minutes. We'll walk you through everything you need to get your daily meal benefits automated.

overview.title: Quick Setup Overview
overview.description: Complete these 4 main steps to activate your WoltFlow automation. Each step has detailed guides linked below.

woltAccount.title: Wolt Account Setup
woltAccount.description: You'll need your Wolt authentication tokens to allow our automation to apply gift cards.

extension.title: WoltFlow Token Reviewer
extension.description: Install our browser extension and copy credentials with one click.

manual.title: Manual Extraction
manual.description: Extract tokens manually using browser developer tools.

deviceConsideration.title: Device Consideration
deviceConsideration.description: Each device has unique tokens. Extract credentials from a device you won't frequently log in/out of Wolt, as this may invalidate tokens.

cibusAccount.title: Cibus Account Setup
cibusAccount.description: Simple credential entry - just your login information that you normally use.

secureStorage.title: Secure Storage
secureStorage.description: All Cibus credentials are encrypted with bank-level security before being stored.

step1.title: Set Up Wolt Credentials
step1.description: Choose your preferred method to extract your Wolt authentication tokens:

extensionMethod.title: Extension Method
extensionMethod.description: Quick and easy with our extension

step2.title: Add Cibus Credentials
step2.description: Go to the Settings page and enter your Cibus login information in the Cibus section.

quickTip.title: 💡 Quick Tip:
quickTip.description: Use the exact same credentials you use to log into Cibus manually.

step3.title: Configure Forwarding
step3.description: Set up SMS and email forwarding to enable full automation:

sms.title: SMS Forwarding
sms.description: Required to handle Cibus 2FA codes automatically during authentication.

email.title: Email Forwarding
email.description: Forward gift card emails to your WoltFlow inbox for automatic code extraction.

step4.title: Activate Automation
step4.description: Configure your automation preferences and activate the daily process:

settings.giftCardAmount: Set gift card amount within your Cibus allowance

allSet.title: You're All Set!
allSet.description: Once activated, WoltFlow will automatically run every day at 12:00 PM Israel time. You'll receive notifications about the status of each run.

readyToBegin.title: Ready to Begin?
readyToBegin.description: Start with getting your Wolt credentials - choose the method that works best for you.
